description: Figure 3 is a stacked bar chart that illustrates the number of datasets categorized as "Targeted" and "Untargeted" from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, and the vertical axis represents the "Number of datasets," with a scale from 0 to 160. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, where the lower blue portion indicates the number of "Untargeted" datasets and the upper orange portion indicates the number of "Targeted" datasets. The data shows a general increase in the number of datasets over time. In 2012, there were no datasets. The number of "Untargeted" datasets remained low until 2017, when it began to increase, peaking in 2021 at approximately 65. The number of "Targeted" datasets also increased over time, with a significant rise starting in 2016, reaching a peak in 2021 at approximately 95. In 2022, the number of "Targeted" datasets was approximately 35, and the number of "Untargeted" datasets was approximately 10. The caption explains that "Targeted" refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition, while "Untargeted" refers to all other datasets that do not meet these criteria. It also notes that the data for 2022 is only partially available.
